info.title: RSVP Gift List API
info.description: Gift List v2 is the canonical surface (D-4). Authorization since 1.11.0 (A9): acting as a guest (reserveGift, listMyReservations, cancelReservation of one's own reservation) requires the guest's own link credential (guestCredential), validated by Guest; any account JWT, including the host and read-only collaborators or organization members (Celebration access READ), answers 403 GUEST_IDENTITY_REQUIRED there. Adding, approving or rejecting gifts, deciding or listing reservations and the gift settings require Celebration access MANAGE (403 HOST_REQUIRED otherwise). READ accounts may only list the items. Reservation events (gift.reservation.requested/auto-committed/confirmed/rejected.v1 and gift.item.released.v1 on rejection) carry payload.guestId while the guest is identified. 1.8.1 (correction, no runtime change): removes POST /items/{giftItemId}/reservations and POST /reservations/{reservationId}/approve. The service never served those paths (reservations go through /guest/celebrations/{celebrationId}/items/{giftItemId}/reservations and /celebrations/{celebrationId}/reservations/{reservationId}/approve), and they duplicated the operationIds reserveGift and approveReservation, which OpenAPI requires to be unique. 1.13.0 (additive, M28; plan de regalos R8a): GET /public/celebrations/{slug}/gifts/summary answers { status: OPEN|EMPTY|CLOSED, itemCount } for the public invitation, anonymous and without personal data (see getPublicGiftsSummary). The host or the organizer (MANAGE) closes or reopens the list by hand with PUT /celebrations/{celebrationId}/gift-list/closure (idempotent); putGiftListClosure answers GiftListView (the list plus closed and closedAt) and listGiftItems gains closed. CLOSED in the summary means closed by hand or the event day is over. Since 1.12.0 (L4) listGiftItems and listReservations return bounded pages: limit 1..200 (default 100) and an opaque cursor; nextCursor is null on the last page. Unknown or repeated query parameters answer 422. 1.10.0 (additive, A5/D-3; PR #60): the guest (link credential) and the host (JWT) cancel an active reservation with POST /celebrations/{celebrationId}/reservations/{reservationId}/cancel, and the guest reads their own reservations back with GET /celebrations/{celebrationId}/my-reservations. 1.14.0 (R1 of the gift series, A28): POST /celebrations/{celebrationId}/items with source CATALOGED refuses a Provider Catalog listing of type SERVICE with 422 GIFT_LISTING_NOT_PRODUCT (only products can be gifts). A v1 item that references a legacy listing which is now a SERVICE stays listed and is answered as not reservable (reservable false; a v1 reservation request is 409 with code GiftNotAvailable) instead of failing the whole list with 503 AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE. Also in 1.14.0 (M-6): a cataloged gift whose listing is no longer a PRODUCT is marked with the new field availability: UNAVAILABLE (always present, AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE, in listGiftItems items; in the owner's private legacy lists, schemas GiftCatalogedItem, GiftLegacyCatalogedItem and PrivateLegacyCatalogGiftItem, where it is optional and present only as UNAVAILABLE, absent meaning available). It is a field of its own, additive and separate from status: DevCompatGiftItemStatus, the frozen v2 item status of GET /celebrations/{celebrationId}/items, is preserved byte for byte by the dev compatibility check and never answers UNAVAILABLE (the gift keeps the status it had, AVAILABLE), and neither do the status enums of the legacy item schemas. Only the host sees it (availability UNAVAILABLE, reservable false in the legacy list); guest lists and the public summary leave it out, and a reservation attempt is refused. Gift reconciles it against Provider Catalog in the background of its worker (a first pass once the worker is ready, then periodically, each pass within a time budget) and through the CLI gift:reconcile-listing-types; it goes back to AVAILABLE when the listing is a PRODUCT again. No event is published for it in 1.14.0 (gift.item.unavailable.v1 arrives with R7). The frozen DevCompatValidation response and DevCompatProblem.code document GIFT_LISTING_NOT_PRODUCT in their descriptions (no structural change). 1.15.0 (additive, R8a follow-up; decisión de Pablo, 2026-11-26): while the host or the organizer holds the list closed by hand (PUT /celebrations/{celebrationId}/gift-list/closure with closed true), a guest cannot reserve a gift on any route: 409 with code LIST_CLOSED (Problem+JSON, status 409, no suggestion) from reserveGift (POST /celebrations/{celebrationId}/items/{giftItemId}/reservations), requestManualGiftReservation and requestModeAwareGiftReservation (the v1 /guest routes, code LIST_CLOSED next to GiftNotAvailable). The check runs after the guest is authenticated and authorized (401/403/404 and the RSVP 403 do not change) and, in reserveGift, after the Idempotency-Key replay: repeating a request that was accepted before the closure returns the stored reservation (header Idempotency-Replayed), not 409; a new key on a closed list is 409 LIST_CLOSED and the key is not stored. The decision is atomic with the closure (the reservation reads the list row FOR SHARE, the closure updates it): a reservation that saw the list open completes before the closure takes effect and one that arrives later is refused. Reservations that already exist are not touched: the host still approves, rejects and cancels them and the guest still cancels theirs; the host keeps adding and editing gifts while the list is closed; reopening (closed false) allows reservations again. The frozen DevCompat parts of reserveGift (the DevCompatGiftNotAvailable response and DevCompatProblem.code) are preserved byte for byte structurally by the dev compatibility check; only their descriptions document the since-1.15.0 LIST_CLOSED code (no structural change), and DevCompatProblem.code is an open string, so the answer is structurally valid. A celebration that is over (the summary says CLOSED because the event day passed) is not blocked by this rule, only a list closed by hand. 1.16.0 (additive, R6a of the gift series: D-10 #32, plan §5.9): listGiftItems answers leadContext, a short-lived token (300 s by default) that Gift signs for an account Celebration confirms as a member of the celebration (host, organizer or collaborator). Partner links of that viewer carry it as ctx in GET /r/{listingId} (provider-catalog 3.7.0), so their clicks are recorded as HOST_OR_PLANNER instead of being billed. It is null for a guest credential, without the signing key, and for any other caller; it carries no personal data. 1.17.0 (additive, R4 of the gift series: A32, M27, server part; plan §5.6, §5.11 and decisions 5, 26, 27, 29): the host or the organizer (MANAGE, PF-3) adds the gifts of the assistant in one call, addGiftItemsBatch (POST /celebrations/{celebrationId}/items/batch, Idempotency-Key required: 428 without it, a replay with the same body answers the same items with Idempotency-Replayed: true, the same key with another body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; all or nothing; at most 25 gifts, one product per idea: 422 DUPLICATE_GIFT_IDEA). Title and price come from Provider Catalog, never from the caller. Only a product Provider Catalog reports as giftEligible (provider-catalog 3.6.0) can be added, here and in addGiftItem: 422 GIFT_LISTING_NOT_ELIGIBLE (an incomplete, hidden, out of stock or over-cap product); a gift already on the list is never turned into a 404 when its product stops being eligible. Items carry quantity (1 to 50, GIFT_MAX_QUANTITY_PER_GIFT), groupGiftEnabled (the 'can be gifted by several' switch), giftIdeaCode and variantCode; updateGiftItem (PATCH /celebrations/{celebrationId}/items/{giftItemId}, host only, version required) changes quantity or the switch (409 QUANTITY_BELOW_RESERVED, 409 GROUP_GIFT_IN_USE, 409 GIFT_VERSION_CONFLICT). The list has deliveryNotes (at most 200 characters, no exact address; set with the batch call or putGiftListDeliveryNotes, PUT /celebrations/{celebrationId}/gift-list/delivery-notes). Reservations carry units, role (SOLE, COORDINATOR, CONTRIBUTOR) and showName; in 1.17.0 every reservation is 1 unit and SOLE: reserving part of a quantity and joining a coordinated gift arrive with R5. The AsyncAPI events are unchanged.

get.summary: State of the gift list for the public invitation (OPEN, EMPTY or CLOSED) and how many gifts a guest sees
get.description: M28 / R8a (1.13.0). Public: no JWT and no guest credential; an Authorization header is ignored. Served by the canonical v2 surface; the gateway route gifts-public-summary forwards it without the /gifts prefix and limits it per client address. Every request resolves the published celebration through Celebration GET /celebrations/public/{slug} (no positive cache): a malformed, unknown or unpublished slug, or a celebration with the gifts section disabled, answers the same 404 CELEBRATION_NOT_FOUND, so existence is never disclosed. itemCount counts the gifts a guest sees in the list (every status except PROPOSED and REJECTED, the same visibility as listGiftItems for non-hosts); a published celebration without a gift list counts 0. status: CLOSED when the host or the organizer closed the list by hand (putGiftListClosure) or when the celebration is over, that is, today in the celebration timeZone is after the local day of content.eventDate (the event day itself is still OPEN; without an event date it is never CLOSED by date); otherwise EMPTY when itemCount is 0 and OPEN when it is not. CLOSED takes precedence over EMPTY. No personal data. HEAD is served like GET without a body.

GuestReservationBearer.description: Single Authorization header with Bearer and an opaque nonempty credential, at most8192 header characters including the Bearer prefix and no controls/internal spaces. Never supplied in URL/body, decoded asJWT, persisted or logged. Missing/malformed credentials return401. When GIFT_GUEST_BASE_URL is absent, a well-formed credential returns503 before DB. When configured, every Guest operation revalidates against the pinned Guest protocol with no positive cache, then reads organizationId from Gift own validated immutable ListCreated root before reservation access. Guest401 maps to UNAUTHORIZED,404 to GIFT_RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND;429, timeouts, redirects, invalid bodies and upstream operational failures map to503 AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE without exposing upstream data. Context contradictions fail503; an absent list404; own DB failures503 PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE.
